candidate.answerReason: An on-line point makes the numerator of the point-to-line distance formula zero. A valid line has a positive denominator, so the distance is 0, choice C.

methods.label: Use the zero numerator
methods.explanation: The coordinates of the point satisfy the equation of the line, so the numerator is 0 and the distance is 0.
